demos.name: Diagram Prove Lab
demos.description: Hosts the validated personal-agent (ChatGPT) and digital-assistant (V2 GW/Authorize) diagrams as diagram-studio data, with a Prove-it-live checklist: every token claim on the diagram maps to a real prompt and the evidence it produced (RFC 8693 sub+act, scope narrowing, HITL). Reusable for validating future diagrams. ReactFlow, movable boxes, Simulate, Reset, presenter mode, Mock/Real toggle.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 7710). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:7710 only). Replace __CHECKOUT__ in composeFile with this checkout's absolute path before adding the entry to the shelf (the shelf requires an absolute path).
